title: Compaction Failure: Conversation Length Exceeds Limit
body:

trying to compact and gett this error.  app used to auto compact.  this is annoying.   /compact

    again.

**Environment Info**

- Terminal: vscode

top_comments.author: completej
top_comments.body:
It's jaw-dropping how neutered claude code w/ API is while this bug persists.  Our team saw months of usage without this issue occuring, while compacting and auto-compacting worked flawlessly.  Once this bug showed up, it completely removed the ability to deal with wide-spread platform changes in a mature codebase.

ESC twice to remove context in order to cirmcumvent this bug 1. works less than half the time and 2. prevents crucial context from being included.  The next context window is limited

top_comments.author: GarlandKey
top_comments.body:
I can duplicate this behavior. When I am done with an issue, I usually run `/compact`. When I do, I get this error:

```error
Error: Error during compaction: Error: Conversation too long. Press esc twice to go up a few messages and try again.
```

Environment Info

    Platform: arch linux
    Terminal: konsole
    Version: 1.0.124

top_comments.author: pepijndevos
top_comments.body:
Hilarious error imo "your context is too long to make shorter"
It seems that you can just keep chatting and auto-compact works somehow.
Could this be some mismatch with the 200k and 1M context versions of Claude?
```
  ⎿  Error: Error during compaction: Error: Conversation too long. Press esc twice to go up a few messages and try again.
```
